requirement: Design-time factory for the Analysis module: build Npgsql options for the analysis database and return an AnalysisDbContext that exposes the ClinicalAnalysis mapping over the clinical_analyses table.

preconditions.text: The factory is constructed directly without a dependency injection container

returns.text: An AnalysisDbContext configured with the Npgsql provider and the clinical_analyses table

exception_text: No unhandled exception; design-time option creation succeeds
